items.content_html: A lightweight course manager built with Vite, TypeScript, and plain HTML/CSS. Users can add, view, and clear university courses, which are saved in localStorage and include course code, name, progression level, and syllabus link. Built as a beginner project to explore OOP, TypeScript, modular structure, and modern tooling.
